documents.detail: Upload the relevant forms alongside certified documents.

documents.title: Application and declarations
documents.detail: Complete the application’s required declarations and witness instructions.

documents.title: Marriage or name-change evidence
documents.detail: Link your earlier and current names using the applicable marriage or deed-poll record. Confirm the upload format with ISD.

documents.title: Translations or accepted multilingual forms
documents.detail: Provide a professionally certified translation and a copy of the original, with the translator’s signature and contact details. An accepted multilingual standard form can replace the translation where permitted.
documents.reason: Makes the records usable in the application.

documents.title: Marriage or name-change evidence
documents.detail: Link your earlier and current names using the applicable marriage or deed-poll record. Confirm the upload format with ISD.

documents.title: Irish Residence Permit
documents.detail: Include your current card and applicable residence permission evidence. A certified IRP can also supply 75 identity points if selected in the identity table; it supplies no residence points.

documents.title: Residence permission history
documents.detail: Check permission dates and the official residence calculator.

documents.title: Marriage certificate
documents.detail: Use the applicable certificate and current certification form.

documents.title: Partner’s Irish citizenship evidence
documents.detail: Provide ONE suitable certified record: Irish passport photo page; Irish birth certificate where it establishes citizenship; naturalisation certificate; Foreign Births Register certificate; or the parent’s Irish birth certificate where citizenship came through that parent.

documents.title: Recent residence proofs for both partners
documents.detail: Provide three different address proofs for EACH partner, covering the three months before applying. Options: utility bills, bank statements, rent/mortgage agreements, or employer/social-welfare letters. Show names, dates and the same address.

documents.title: Spouse declaration
documents.detail: Use the correct ISD declaration for your relationship.

documents.title: Civil partnership certificate
documents.detail: Use the applicable certificate and current certification form.

documents.title: Civil partner declaration
documents.detail: Use the correct ISD declaration for your relationship.

type_a.title: Revenue Employment Detail Summary
type_a.note: Your own name and the claimed year.

type_a.title: P60
type_a.note: For an older year for which a P60 was issued.

type_a.title: DSP Annual Contribution Statement
type_a.note: Must show contributions or claims; an empty record is insufficient.

type_a.title: DSP Payment Statement
type_a.note: Accepted DSP alternative; child benefit alone is insufficient.

type_a.title: Bank statements
type_a.note: Show Irish point-of-sale activity and outlet addresses. The guide specifies at least 3 transactions per month for 3 months. Check the portal's requested coverage.

type_a.title: Employer letter confirming employment dates
type_a.note: Dates must cover the claimed period.

type_b.title: Utility bill
type_b.note: Gas, electricity, water or broadband. Show your name, address and date.

type_b.title: School / college letter
type_b.note: Show residence and relevant attendance dates; dependent applicants have separate rules.

type_b.title: IPAS / Direct Provision letter
type_b.note: Proves where you lived; does not make asylum-waiting time count as qualifying residence.

other_residence.title: Annual mortgage statement
other_residence.note: 50 points in the 2024 scorecard. Not separately listed in the current table; confirm with ISD before relying on it.

other_residence.title: Medical Practitioner Employment History Summary
other_residence.note: HSE / voluntary-hospital doctors: 50 in the 2024 scorecard; currently accepted, but the current page does not restate a score. Confirm with ISD.

other_residence.title: Bin collection, TV licence, cable / satellite bill
other_residence.note: Listed as residence examples; the current proofs page does not give an individual score.

other_residence.title: Tenancy-board correspondence
other_residence.note: Listed as evidence; confirm its category and points.

other_residence.title: Local property tax / other government or social-welfare correspondence
other_residence.note: Listed as evidence; confirm its category and points. DSP annual statements are listed separately above.
